# Chimera II OS — Rust Edition

Separate Rust workspace providing safe user-space/runtime research components for Chimera II OS. It mirrors RegisterN, ISA, quantum and multidimensional concepts without claiming that the workspace is itself a signed bootable kernel.

Crates: `chm-core`, `chm-register`, `chm-isa`, `chm-quantum`, `chm-multidim`, `chm-cli`.
